name: iolta
description: Northfield Law Group (fictional) client trust account (IOLTA) ledger: the trust journal of client-money movements, point-in-time bank reconciliations, and the fee invoices behind earned-fee transfers. Synthetic demo data; all money in integer cents. Client-level data is identified only by client and matter IDs.
domain: law firm client trust account (IOLTA): trust journal, bank reconciliations and fee invoices
notes: The trust journal balance is the signed total of trust_journal: CLIENT_DEPOSIT and FIRM_BUFFER_IN add, CLIENT_DISBURSEMENT and EARNED_FEE_TRANSFER subtract.

Each client's ledger balance is that same signed total filtered to one client_id. The sum of all client ledgers must equal the journal balance; a trust_journal row with client_id NULL is an unidentified deposit that breaks the tie.
client_id 'FIRM-BUFFER' is the firm's own ledger card for the small balance a bank allows in trust to cover service charges; any larger firm balance is commingling.
The adjusted bank balance is bank_statement_balance_cents + deposits_in_transit_cents - outstanding_checks_cents, read from the most recent snapshot.
An EARNED_FEE_TRANSFER is supported only when its invoice_id names a fee_invoices row and the transfer does not exceed that invoice.
The client_contacts table (names, emails, phones, addresses) is intentionally omitted: this engine never reads client PII. The ledger identifies clients and matters by ID only.
